Claude Code Token Budgeting

TokenTrim is a free, local toolkit that helps extend Claude Code usage limits by optimizing tool output and file reading. By using TokenTrim, developers can make their Claude Code token budget last roughly 4x longer.

What you get

Free local toolkit, $49 lifetime Pro upgrade, $9/month Pro subscription

Why tokentrim

TokenTrim is designed for developers and CTOs at 10-200 person US software companies who hit Claude Code limits. It provides a dashboard to track token spend per session, helping teams optimize their Claude Code usage.

FAQ

Is TokenTrim affiliated with Anthropic? No, TokenTrim is not affiliated with Anthropic.

What is the benefit of upgrading to Pro? Upgrading to Pro provides additional features and support.

Next step: Download TokenTrim for free and start optimizing your Claude Code token budget today.
